protocol.model: course XGBoost; no class weights; fixed after fitting
protocol.permutation: one column at a time; common row order per repeat
protocol.sd: sample standard deviation across permutations; ddof=1
protocol.uncertainty: conditional on fitted model and observed patient set
protocol.top10_criterion: descending mean Brier increase across all features
protocol.rank_ties: average rank among all features in each repeat
protocol.boxplot: median, Q1-Q3, 1.5 IQR whiskers; all repeats shown
protocol.before_sd: zero across these repeats by construction; no resampling
